Mod.Name: 对话框下移 / Lower Dialogue Box
Mod.Author: 远风肆业
Mod.Description:
下移普通顾客、持枪瞄准及治安官检查时的对话框和姓名框，减少遮挡脸部。仅调整 UI 位置，可独立使用，启用或更新后重启游戏。
Moves dialogue and name boxes lower for regular customers, weapon aiming, and security inspections. UI positions only. Works independently; restart after enabling or updating.
